name: Start Word Bites and verify the installable app shell
description: Verifies the primary mobile gameplay flow and that the deployed app exposes its installable PWA shell.
steps: Open Word Bites with fresh local progress
Dismiss onboarding and enter the first level
Drag across letters and release
Inspect the browser install option and then reload with the network unavailable
expected: Gameplay remains usable, the PWA manifest and service worker load, and the cached app shell opens offline.

name: Automatically advance after completing a puzzle and resume saved progress
covers: progressive difficulty from Normal through Expert and higher mastery tiers
increasing letter-pool complexity and randomized starting wheel positions
difficulty-scaled hint costs and shorter advanced timed challenges
description: Verifies that completing every required word automatically opens the next puzzle and Play resumes the last active puzzle with its found words intact after reopening.
steps: Start a puzzle and find one or more required words without completing it
Close or reload Word Bites
Tap Play and verify the same puzzle and found words are restored
Complete all remaining required words and verify the next level is harder than the previous one
Advance through Normal, Tricky, Hard, Expert, Master, Grandmaster, and Legend milestones and verify letter pools and hint costs increase
Wait for the short completion transition without tapping a next button
Return home and tap Play again
expected: Play restores the last active puzzle and its found words; each completion advances automatically through progressively harder tiers from Normal to Tricky, Hard, Expert, Master, Grandmaster, and Legend, with more letter complexity, randomized wheel positions, and increasingly costly hints.

name: Recover safely from malformed or unavailable local progress
description: Verifies invalid saved progress cannot crash the app or produce an unusable level.
steps: Open Word Bites with saved progress containing invalid or out-of-range level and resume values
Navigate to gameplay
Complete or leave the level
expected: Word Bites normalizes invalid saved values, opens a valid level, and remains usable without a blank screen.

name: Use themes, settings, navigation, and recovery controls
covers: bakery hero illustration and polished game surfaces
description: Verifies secondary screens remain navigable and state changes do not destabilize the app.
steps: Open Themes and select Honey Gold, Emerald Green, Electric Purple, and Light Mode in turn
Verify Purple is the dark appearance and each selection recolours cards, buttons, game tiles, and navigation
Inspect the bakery hero illustration, decorative game-card art, polished letter tiles, and theme preview swatches
Open Settings and change text size
Open How to Play, then use back navigation and visit Profile, Dictionary, Achievements, and Events
expected: Each appearance applies across all screens, Electric Purple provides the dark palette, the selected appearance persists after reload, and navigation remains usable.

name: Handle gameplay edge cases and daily completion safely
description: Verifies common gameplay actions and ensures a completed daily puzzle cannot repeatedly award completion rewards.
steps: Rapidly select and release letters several times
Use Shuffle repeatedly during a normal level, then drag across the newly positioned letters to form and submit a word
Use hints during a normal level
Complete the daily puzzle and return to it again on the same day
expected: After every shuffle, the selection line follows the letters' current displayed positions, the old drag path is cleared, and words can still be formed and submitted; timers stop when leaving timed play, and the daily completion reward is granted only once per day.
